data: What is the approximate value of the red line at the 30th iteration?

The red line represents the dual value L(u(k)) for a fixed step size of 0.01. The y-axis shows the value of the dual value L(u(k)), ranging from -13 to -16. The x-axis represents the number of iterations, ranging from 0 to 40. At the 30th iteration, the red line appears to be approximately at -15.
